implementation_status_authority: coding and root evidence receipts; this contract does not assert execution
density_meaning: proper number density in a common H/He material rest frame

input_state.model: rei_microphysics::HHeModel, or Ft03Model.gas for density only
input_state.upstream_validation: call public HHeModel::electron_density before constructing BASS state; do not bypass model/state validation
input_state.upstream_zero_nuclei_policy: HHeModel rejects n_H+n_He=0; preserve this rejection
forbidden_substitutions: volume filling factor Q_V for x_HII
H-normalized free electron fraction for x_HII
normal-frame density for material proper density
input_state.FT03_temperature_guard: not an extra opacity boundary requirement; actual FT03 trajectory calls retain their own guard

electron_conversion.conversion_overflow: reject through finite-domain validation; no silent clipping or infinity

ray_clock.direction_meaning: future photon propagation direction in normal tetrad; unit norm validated by existing frame API
ray_clock.beta_meaning: material velocity relative to normal observer divided by c
ray_clock.atomic_clock_equation: d tau_material/d t_normal=1/gamma along material worldline

history.time_grid: finite strictly increasing normal time edges in seconds
history.sample_rule: one left-endpoint HHe snapshot and frame/direction per interval; fixed throughout that interval
history.time_order: future increasing; backward optical-depth tail sum is not backward kinetic evolution
history.observer_tail: finite dimensionless nonnegative supplied depth beyond final edge

error_transport.comparison_preconditions: same ray, normal-time edges and observer tail
does_not_bound: atomic-source uncertainty without n_e trajectory bound

derived_only_FLRW_mapping.current_coding_trajectory: static controlled FT03, beta=0 chemistry; supplied fixed-frame ray postprocessing does not evolve tilted chemistry

RCT_direct_electron_source.indirect_history_effect: possible through later chemistry/temperature; not determined by this identity

stop_condition: actual typed density bridge plus existing fixed-input ray/visibility reuse are tested against analytic and independent references; stop before creating a new atomic/geometry history or promoting Thomson-domain gates
